title: The Eternal Embrace of the Trinity

blocks.s: Furthermore: the eternal Father with all who live in him, as a living depth, is turned actively and operatively toward his Son as toward his own wisdom; and the Son with all who live in him is reflected actively and operatively back to the Father — the depth from whom he flowed. In this encounter of Father and Son the third Person flows from both; this Love of both, with such opulence and joy, actively and fruitively embraces and penetrates Father and Son, that all creatures must be silent about it: for that wonderful and incomprehensible reality is superexalted above the intellect of all creatures. Where, therefore, that wonderful is understood and savoured without wonder, there the spirit stands above itself, and is one with the Spirit of God, and sees and savours like God the opulence which is God himself, without measure, in the unity or union of the living depth. This wonderful encounter is continuously renewed in us in active mode without intermission. For the Father gives himself in the Son and the Son in the Father in a certain eternal complacency and loving embrace, namely the Holy Spirit. And this also is ceaselessly renewed in the spirit of the contemplating soul every hour.
